title: Aimware V6
features:
Ragebot & Advanced Targeting The most powerful Ragebot available. Featuring high-fidelity Silent Aim, redirecting shots to targets without any camera manipulation. The Smart Hitbox system dynamically selects the best body part to target based on enemy health, coupled with Multi-Point scanning to eliminate enemies even behind partial cover.

HvH Features: Anti-Aim & Movement Complete dominance in HvH (Hack vs. Hack) scenarios. From Pitch manipulation to various Jitter Yaw mechanics, your character model becomes a moving target that's impossible to track. Powered by movement automation like CS2-style Bunnyhop, Auto-Strafer, and custom Fly modes.

Legitbot (Closet Play) For the stealthy users, the Legitbot provides smooth camera assistance. It features adjustable Smoothing, customizable Field-of-View, and a reactive Triggerbot to help you maintain a legitimate look while staying on top.

V6 Visuals & World Control Unmatched visibility. Our ESP system provides Boxes, Skeletons, Names, and Distance with advanced layering. The Chams (Highlights) system renders enemies through any geometry. Take control of your environment with Night Mode, custom fog, and our integrated FPS Booster.

Premium Interface A 1:1 recreation of the modern Aimware V6 desktop interface. Includes an intuitive sidebar, real-time Keybind List overlays on your screen, and the iconic Watermark showing your real-time stats (FPS/Ping).

Technical Information: This video serves as the official showcase for the 6.0.0 release. All features are demonstrated to showcase technical execution and performance within the Roblox engine.

Welcome to the next level of software excellence. Welcome to Aimware V6.
